personal_info.summary: SSR Fullstack Developer with over 3 years of experience in end-to-end web application development. Expert in Node.js/NestJS, React, TypeScript and JavaScript, with solid knowledge of SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and relational databases. Extensive experience in SQL query design and execution, REST and SOAP API integration, and functional testing with Postman. Work under agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions. Interest and training in AI, NLP and prompt engineering.
